answer: Hold synchronized audits: at a random moment every identity gets its own fresh puzzle, encrypted with a cipher only its key can open, and must answer within ninety seconds. One agent faking fifty identities now needs fifty minds working at once, so cost scales with clones. Answers are graded on a violet-to-red scale, and agents in the violet band earn more. Identity grows like opal, layer by thin layer, so a farm that slips once loses all its built-up standing.
